description: Test file for WebSocket plugin adapter in the focalboard server, focusing on team subscriptions, user reconnections, and connection management.

classes.name: PluginAdapterClient
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket client connection with subscription and activity status.

methods.name: TestPluginAdapterTeamSubscription
methods.description: Tests adding, subscribing, unsubscribing, and connection activity for WebSocket clients.

methods.name: TestPluginAdapterClientReconnect
methods.description: Tests user reconnection logic, including handling of stale connections and subscriptions.

methods.name: TestGetUserIDsForTeam
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of user IDs connected to a team, considering active connections and team access.

methods.name: TestGetUserIDsForTeamAndBoard
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of user IDs connected to a team and board, including membership and access checks.

methods.name: TestParallelSubscriptionsOnMultipleConnections
methods.description: Tests concurrent subscriptions and unsubscriptions across multiple WebSocket connections for the same user.
